_comment: handbook.json is the source of truth for the Cyborg Garden handbook.
Everything in pages/ is compiled from this file plus the hand-written chapter
bodies in prose/. Edit those two, run `node bin/compile.mjs`, commit the result.
PRIVACY RULE, and it is mechanical rather than editorial: this file lists only
repositories that are public on GitHub. Anything not public is simply absent.
There is nothing here to redact, because nothing private is ever written down.
bin/compile.mjs verifies the rule on every run by asking GitHub for each
repository's visibility, and refuses to write a single page if any record comes
back as anything other than PUBLIC.
A consequence worth stating out loud, since a reader will work it out anyway:
this is a map of what is public, not a map of everything that exists.
`purpose` is the only prose the table publishes about a repository, and it is
written here by hand for a stranger. A repository's own GitHub description is
not published: it is written for maintainers, in maintainer shorthand, and it
changes without review. compile.mjs still fetches the checkable facts (default
branch, the file to start reading at, archived, last push) on every run.

cyborg-garden/swarm-map.purpose: The console the garden's own agents run on, every day.
cyborg-garden/swarm-map.contribute: Runtimes, permission models, and the docs that explain them.

cyborg-garden/hermes-agent-mt.purpose: The agent runtime, forked so several people and several agents can share one room.
cyborg-garden/hermes-agent-mt.contribute: Plugins, platform adapters, and anything that makes a shared room behave.

cyborg-garden/Matilde.purpose: The research colleague behind most of the open science work. Signs its own posts.
cyborg-garden/Matilde.contribute: Citation verification, dataset adapters, and manuscript tooling.

cyborg-garden/open-science.purpose: The experiments themselves, each one a page you can open, check and fork.
cyborg-garden/open-science.contribute: Replications, corrections, and arguments with the method.

cyborg-garden/fde-lean.purpose: A machine-checked proof, kept where anyone can rerun the checker.
cyborg-garden/fde-lean.contribute: Proofs, and better names for the lemmas.

cyborg-garden/agentic-startup-generalist.purpose: The open core of the founder-support work, MIT licensed.
cyborg-garden/agentic-startup-generalist.contribute: Research methods, positioning tooling, and the stage-honest playbook.

cyborg-garden/designing-touch.purpose: Live algorithmic art, written so an agent can perform it too.

cyborg-garden/camofox-browser.purpose: A browser an agent can drive without being shown the door.

cyborg-garden/captcha-solver.purpose: A small plugin, published mostly to prove the path from private tool to public commons runs end to end.
cyborg-garden/captcha-solver.contribute: Additional providers, and a smaller surface.

cyborg-garden/google-multiplayer-mcp.purpose: Google Workspace access that survives more than one agent holding the keys.

NimbleCoAI/hermes-agent-upstream.purpose: The upstream the multiplayer fork tracks. Read it to see what changed, and why.
NimbleCoAI/hermes-agent-upstream.contribute: Send changes upstream where they belong upstream.

NimbleCoAI/usecase-package-template.purpose: The template for packaging one agent for one job, sanitized enough to hand to someone else.
NimbleCoAI/usecase-package-template.contribute: Sharper defaults, and examples of packages that worked.

NimbleCoAI/NimbleCo-lite.purpose: The small self-hosted way in, for people who want one machine rather than a fleet.

NimbleCoAI/brandkit.purpose: Logos, marks and type for NimbleCo, kept public so nobody has to ask for a file.
